script: I'd like users to be able to save multiple delivery addresses in their profile. At the moment they have to replace the existing address. They should be able to add several addresses and select one as the default address during checkout.
facts: Users can save multiple delivery addresses in their profile
Current limitation: users have to replace the existing address
Users can select one address as the default address during checkout
